correctness.rationale: In odd characteristic, pairwise associative commutation of odd parts is exterior orthogonality. Wedge-degree 2 forces the degree-one tuple rank <=1. On the nonzero rank-one locus a complete affine chart is parametrized by alpha_1,beta_1,eta_j,zeta_j of dimensions 20,6,10,5 and rank-one linear data, giving dim X_s=48s+16; substitution verifies ALL pair constraints. On zero degree-one locus the wedge pairing of 20 degree-three monomials is nondegenerate alternating; its isotropic tuple variety is irreducible and rational via Lagrangian incidence, dimension Y_s=58s-s(s-1)/2 for s<=10 and 48s+55 otherwise. Its dimension exceeds X for every s>=3, proving exactly two components. Counting symplectic isotropic ordered frames plus rank-one matrices yields the exact odd-q formula. A fresh finite-field wedge test and brute-force small symplectic enumerations agreed with the formula, including 736,36352,26001.
